data.description:
## What Is Chiliz (CHZ)?

[Chiliz](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/chiliz/) is the native token of Chiliz Chain, the Layer-1 blockchain for Sports and Entertainment. It also powers the [Socios.com](https://www.socios.com/) Wallet, the leading fan engagement platform where fans can engage with their favorite sports and entertainment brands through [Fan Tokens](https://coinmarketcap.com/view/fan-token/). 

Within the Socios.com Wallet, fans can use their Fan Tokens to vote on governance polls, redeem rewards such as signed merchandise and (VIP) match tickets, and get access to unique physical and digital experiences. For sports clubs and associations, Fan Tokens offer a way of connecting with their fans and unlocking new revenue streams.

Chiliz has partnered with some of the world’s most iconic sports brands — including [FC Barcelona](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/fc-barcelona-fan-token/), [Manchester City](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/manchester-city-fan-token/), [Juventus](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/juventus-fan-token/), and [Paris Saint-Germain](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/paris-saint-germain-fan-token/) — and continues to expand into esports, gaming, and broader entertainment verticals.


## Who Is the Founder of Chiliz (CHZ)?

Chiliz was founded by Alexandre Dreyfus, its current CEO. Dreyfus has over 20 years of experience founding and growing web-based companies. For instance, he developed Webcity, an interactive travel guide, and Winamax and Chilipoker, both online poker projects, before founding Chiliz in 2017. His explicit goal with the company is to “work harder than ever on our mission to fully establish Fan Tokens as the ultimate fan engagement tool and as a powerful new revenue generator for the sports industry.” This has been highlighted in the aggressive expansion of Fan Tokens that have seen numerous European football powerhouses, but also smaller clubs sign on.


## What Makes Chiliz (CHZ) Unique?

Every sporting organization using the Chiliz technology has a limited supply of Fan Tokens that are offered at an initial FTO (Fan Token Offering). These tokens are offered on a first-come-first-serve basis, with the opening price and fully diluted market cap disclosed by Chiliz beforehand. The native CHZ token is used to purchase Fan Tokens and acts as the platform’s internal currency. Fans can then vote on the Socios platform with their Fan Tokens, a process made possible using [smart contracts](https://coinmarketcap.com/alexandria/glossary/smart-contract). Clubs determine the amount of influence fans have. Decisions can range from new jersey designs to deciding team matchups in exhibition games.

## How Many Chiliz (CHZ) Coins Are There in Circulation?

At launch in October 2018, the total supply of CHZ was fixed at 8.8 billion tokens, distributed across early contributors, strategic partners, and exchange sales. Initially, CHZ was issued as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum, with additional compatibility as BEP-2 on Binance Chain and TRC-20 on Tron.

Following the migration to the Chiliz Chain, this fixed-supply model was replaced by a dynamic tokenomics framework designed to ensure the long-term sustainability, security, and growth of the ecosystem. These changes were implemented on May 6th, 2024, via the “Dragon 8” upgrade, after approval through on-chain governance (85.13% of votes in favor, 0% against).

**Chiliz Tokenomics 2.0**
Inflationary Model:
An initial 8.80% annual base inflation in Year 1, decreasing gradually each year until stabilizing at a 1.88% inflation floor after 14 years.

Perpetual Burning Mechanism:
Inspired by Ethereum’s EIP-1559, the majority of transaction fees are permanently burned at the protocol level, offsetting inflation and creating a balancing effect on total supply.

Circulating Supply:
Due to the new model, the supply of CHZ is no longer fixed. At the time of drafting, 12th of September 2025, the circulating supply stands at 9,980,635,902 CHZ, but this figure increases daily as new tokens are minted. Projections estimate the supply will gradually rise to ~15 billion CHZ over 14 years (2038) before stabilizing with the inflation floor.

Allocation of Newly Minted CHZ:
Each block introduces new CHZ into circulation, distributed as follows:
* 65% – Allocated to the block-producing validator and shared with their delegators (minus validator commission).
* 10% – Community Vault, Liquidity Providers (LPs), and Shared Security Restaking Rewards.
* 25% – Ecosystem & Operational (E&O) Distribution.

This dynamic model ensures that validators and delegators are continuously incentivized, while also providing a sustainable funding mechanism for ecosystem development and security.

The full Chiliz Tokenomics 2.0 can be found [here](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-chiliz-chain/tokenomics).


## How Is the Chiliz Network Secured?

The Chiliz Chain is a dedicated Layer-1 blockchain built for the sports and entertainment industries. It is a fork of BNB Smart Chain (BSC), which itself derives from go-Ethereum (geth). This makes the network Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) compatible, allowing it to interact with and execute Ethereum-based smart contracts seamlessly.

Security and consensus on the Chiliz Chain are maintained through a Proof-of-Staked-Authority (PoSA) mechanism — a hybrid model that combines Proof-of-Authority (PoA) and Proof-of-Stake (PoS). Under PoSA, a limited set of validators take turns producing blocks in a PoA fashion, while their ability to serve as validators depends on the amount of CHZ staked in support of them.

Validators are the backbone of the network, responsible for validating transactions, producing blocks, and safeguarding the chain’s integrity. Two types of validators exist:
* Main Validators – actively produce blocks and commit them to the blockchain.
* Candidate Validators – remain in standby and can be promoted if a Main Validator is penalized or becomes unavailable.

Beyond securing the network, validators also play a crucial role in on-chain governance. Their voting power is proportional to the amount of CHZ staked, giving them influence over proposals that shape the evolution of the chain.

Community members can contribute to network security as delegators, by staking their CHZ with validators. Delegators indirectly participate in governance while helping to secure the chain. In return, they receive a share of the rewards earned by validators — sourced from transaction tips and CHZ block rewards.

This staking-driven model ensures that the Chiliz Chain remains secure, efficient, and community-governed, while supporting the creation and management of digital assets tailored to sports and entertainment.
